title: Joy: a fox that looks like Joy
kaylee: Aunt Joy at Agong's house is a proper fox now, with Joy's long hair, big smile and lace blouse. Since your notes: no white beard (only her snout is white), and smaller, all-orange ears.
questions: Does she look like Joy to you now?
Inside her ears is a paler orange so they still read as ears. Good, or plain orange all through?
